nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Dusk. The mast hums. Out past the fence, the treeline is moving.)

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Listen to me. Your mast is loud. Something heard it. Husks, a lot of them, walking straight at you.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Enough. Get the kids inside. Get your best four on the line.

choices.text: We could shut the mast off.
Tell me how to hold them.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: They've already heard it. Turning it off now just means you can't hear me.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Overwatch. Somebody watches, the rest wait. Anyone in the open, Brace. Use the towers if you built them.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Keep the mast standing. If it falls, I can't help you for a while. Lantern standing by.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Those Husks had Link chips in them. Pull them. There's data on them. Old, but real.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: And here. Workshop plans, the heavy kind. You've earned bigger tools.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Yeah, kid. They were people. Somebody switched them off and forgot to turn the lights out.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: ...Ask me again when you're older. I'll tell you then. Promise.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Somewhere on channel nine, the singing stops. Just for a moment. Then it starts again.)

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The mast lies across the yard. Pell is sorting the wire into piles that make sense only to him.)

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: I can fix it. It'll take days. But I can fix it.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: She'll come back. She always comes back.
